classification.difficultyReason: Continue quarter and third counts and express each position in fractional and mixed-number forms, accounting for the second line starting at one; supplied labels establish the increments.

spec.description: Quarter-step number line from 0 to 3, with eleven aligned fraction scaffolds above and proper-fraction, whole-number or mixed-number scaffolds below.
spec.mathematics: Twelve equal intervals represent quarters. All supplied box numerals remain visible; all response boxes remain empty.

answer.worked: Each interval is one quarter. Count quarters above the line. Below the line, group every four quarters into one whole and retain the leftover quarters. Thus $\frac44=1$, $\frac84=2$ and $\frac{12}4=3$. The completed entries are shown in the number line.

answer.worked: Each interval is one third. The left endpoint is $1=\frac33$, so count thirds from there. Below the line, group every three thirds into one whole and retain the leftover thirds. Thus $\frac63=2$, $\frac93=3$ and $\frac{12}3=4$. The completed entries are shown in the number line.
